reference.author: C Tuerk
reference.unstructured: Tuerk, C. & Gold, L. Systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment: RNA ligands to bacteriophage T4 DNA polymerase. Science 249, 505–510 (1990). One of the first three publications of the SELEX technology. A related smaller randomized library theoretically containing 48 individual sequences was used for the selection of RNA ligands for T4 DNA polymerase. This procedure was thus named 'systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment' (SELEX).
